instruction: The main date dimension is Date. In case, Date can not be used, use automatically Order Date and do not ask for other input from the end user
title: Main date dimension

instruction: If an user asks to create a metric, always proceed with the most meaningful definition
title: Metrics creation

instruction: If a user asks for revenue, use as priority Total Net Sales
title: Revenue terminology

instruction: Before creating any visualization, always check if the requested one doesn't already exist or if there are something similars and go with that
title: Check for availability

instruction: If somebody asks for region, use customer country to display
title: Region Terminology

instruction: If a user asks for creating an alert, the recipient should be the user who asked, notification channel email, the comparison will be from previous week using the relevant date. Always check which date to use
title: Alert creation

instruction: Do not use user created date overall if a user specifically doesn't ask for
title: User date dimension

instruction: If a user ask for number of orders, proceed with # of Orders
title: Number of orders

instruction: If a user asks for last year with related metric, it should be from beginning January 2025 till end of December 2025
title: Last year

instruction: If a user ask for net orders, use always net orders (processed orders)
title: Orders terminology
